_comment: Multi-tile world objects. Each entry also registers an item with the same id (category placeable_object) so furniture can be picked up (E) and re-placed. kind: scrap (found furniture) | station | chest | bed | light | door | portal (interior doorway: non-solid, fixed, teleports to its linked twin; open_sprite = the open frame). size = [w, h] cells (8 px; sprite px = size * 8), anchored bottom-left. Scrap yields are the FULL (station) yield; in-place scrapping applies FIELD_SCRAP_YIELD. tool_tier = minimum tool tier to scrap in place (0 = hands). skill = required Scrapping level. sprite = assets/sprites/objects/<id>.png. Yields are generous on purpose: depletion comes from objects running out (LT-27), not from stingy rolls. Harvest gates (GL-28, finalized M5): skill follows the best material tier in the yields - wood/cloth/plastic/stone 0, metal furniture 0-1 as authored, anything yielding iron needs Scrapping 2, steel needs Scrapping 3.
